newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates dip on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates dip on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates dipped on Wednesday as spinners kept to the sidelines awaiting a relief package for the textile industry likely to be announced by the caretaker government, dealers said.
The government is expected to revise duties on import of raw cotton and synthetic fibres to help the textile industry cope with a shortfall in domestic cotton output.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,150 rupees ($53.45) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
